facts.name: EndActorTagRegistry_FindActorByTag
facts.note: (const FName* key) -> AActor* or 0: the tag registry's Tags[0] lookup both PlayerTrigger routers use. Same shape in both builds (chkstk, registry Get, impl call); the IDA agent matched it, and the main session read both exes' bytes with capstone (2026-10-09). The ladder vtable 0x145940748 -> 0x1457A2650 is already in replaced-traversal.json; its trigger slots read +0x710/+0x718 -> 0x1409DC534/0x1409DB844 (1.004) and +0x718/+0x720 -> 0x140D813D0/0x140D81588 (1.005).
